meta.description: As night falls, the truth is finally revealed.

spans.text: Well, let's take a look. This scroll looks like a letter of some kind.

units.rawText: Dear Jack: I've obtained the Coal Core, but I haven't been able to break the seal on it no matter what I've tried.
units.displayText: Dear Jack: I've obtained the Coal Core, but I haven't been able to break the seal on it no matter what I've tried.

spans.text: Dear Jack: I've obtained the Coal Core, but I haven't been able to break the seal on it no matter what I've tried.

units.rawText: Huh? Wasn't Jack from that story Miss Anna was telling at the beginning?
units.displayText: Huh? Wasn't Jack from that story Miss Anna was telling at the beginning?

spans.text: Huh? Wasn't Jack from that story Miss Anna was telling at the beginning?

units.rawText: Who would have thought a ghost story to get people in the mood would be part of the game too... Let's keep reading.

spans.text: Who would have thought a ghost story to get people in the mood would be part of the game too... Let's keep reading.

units.rawText: Not only does the seal keep you here, but it also deploys numerous barriers to keep me from approaching. I cannot stay here to experiment for long. However, I have found a way to break it.
units.displayText: Not only does the seal keep you here, but it also deploys numerous barriers to keep me from approaching. I cannot stay here to experiment for long. However, I have found a way to break it.

spans.text: Not only does the seal keep you here, but it also deploys numerous barriers to keep me from approaching. I cannot stay here to experiment for long. However, I have found a way to break it.

units.displayText: It seems the writer has a close relationship to Pumpkin Jack.

spans.text: It seems the writer has a close relationship to Pumpkin Jack.

units.rawText: Since that damn king laid the seal, I guess only one of his bloodline can break it.
units.displayText: Since that damn king laid the seal, I guess only one of his bloodline can break it.

units.rawText: The King...
units.displayText: The King...

spans.text: The King...

units.rawText: So I'm trying to get someone of his bloodline to come here. By the time you see this letter, the person standing before you will surely be the scion of the author of our suffering. Feel free to help yourself!
units.displayText: So I'm trying to get someone of his bloodline to come here. By the time you see this letter, the person standing before you will surely be the scion of the author of our suffering. Feel free to help yourself!

spans.text: Eh? Wait a minute... is this "scion" they're talking about... the princess that I'm playing?

units.rawText: I can't believe you actually saw through my secret. I thought this little princess would be easy to control, but I didn't expect that she would become the reason you learned everything.
units.displayText: I can't believe you actually saw through my secret. I thought this little princess would be easy to control, but I didn't expect that she would become the reason you learned everything.

spans.text: Miss Witch... you lied to me... then... then my curse...

units.rawText: Humph. I laid it, of course. After all, your flesh and blood is needed to unseal Pumpkin Jack.

(Stall for time.)

units.rawText: We have the advantage in numbers.
units.displayText: We have the advantage in numbers.

spans.text: We might be able to take advantage of the storm she created.

units.rawText: As you command.
units.displayText: As you command.

spans.text: As you command.

units.displayText: Cap-Captain Yanny... The anchor's stuck! I can't pull it back!

spans.text: Cap-Captain Yanny... The anchor's stuck! I can't pull it back!

spans.text: Princess Helix frantically tries to pull the anchor up, but it refuses to budge from its place on the seafloor.

spans.text: Move aside, Princess!

units.displayText: Captain Yanny grabs an axe and brings it down on the chain that holds the ship in place.

spans.text: Captain Yanny grabs an axe and brings it down on the chain that holds the ship in place.

spans.text: There is a sound of metal on metal, and amidst a shower of sparks, a break appears in the chain.

units.rawText: Too slow!
units.displayText: Too slow!

spans.text: Too slow!

units.rawText: The gigantic witch is already diving down on the ship.
units.displayText: The gigantic witch is already diving down on the ship.

spans.text: The gigantic witch is already diving down on the ship.

units.rawText: Boom—
units.displayText: Boom—

spans.text: Boom—

units.rawText: (Coughs) What... was that...
units.displayText: (Coughs) What... was that...

spans.text: (Coughs) What... was that...

units.rawText: A cannonball soaked in holy water. Even if it cannot defeat you, it can still slow you down.
units.displayText: A cannonball soaked in holy water. Even if it cannot defeat you, it can still slow you down.

spans.text: A cannonball soaked in holy water. Even if it cannot defeat you, it can still slow you down.

units.rawText: Clotho aims at the image of the Witch in the air.
units.displayText: Clotho aims at the image of the Witch in the air.

spans.text: Clotho aims at the image of the Witch in the air.

units.rawText: Adjust the firing angle, 15 degrees down.
units.displayText: Adjust the firing angle, 15 degrees down.

spans.text: Adjust the firing angle, 15 degrees down.

units.rawText: <size=40>FIRE!</size>
units.displayText: FIRE!

spans.text: FIRE!

units.rawText: Clotho pulls the firing cord, and the cannonball strikes the Witch's image.
units.displayText: Clotho pulls the firing cord, and the cannonball strikes the Witch's image.

spans.text: Clotho pulls the firing cord, and the cannonball strikes the Witch's image.

units.rawText: You think that mere cannon and holy water can stop me!?
units.displayText: You think that mere cannon and holy water can stop me!?

spans.text: You think that mere cannon and holy water can stop me!?

units.rawText: No! But it's already bought us enough time!
units.displayText: No! But it's already bought us enough time!

spans.text: No! But it's already bought us enough time!

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: The combination of a mighty cleave from Captain Yanny and the ship's movement causes the chain tying the ship down to tear apart with the sound of ripping metal.
units.displayText: The combination of a mighty cleave from Captain Yanny and the ship's movement causes the chain tying the ship down to tear apart with the sound of ripping metal.

spans.text: The combination of a mighty cleave from Captain Yanny and the ship's movement causes the chain tying the ship down to tear apart with the sound of ripping metal.

units.rawText: Trim the sails! We're getting out of here!
units.displayText: Trim the sails! We're getting out of here!

spans.text: Trim the sails! We're getting out of here!

units.rawText: It's useless! You can't escape!
units.displayText: It's useless! You can't escape!

spans.text: It's useless! You can't escape!

units.rawText: Awawawa! What should I do, what should I do... Ah! I've got it!
units.displayText: Awawawa! What should I do, what should I do... Ah! I've got it!

spans.text: Awawawa! What should I do, what should I do... Ah! I've got it!

units.rawText: Helix grabs a barrel of supplies and throws it into the water.
units.displayText: Helix grabs a barrel of supplies and throws it into the water.

spans.text: Helix grabs a barrel of supplies and throws it into the water.

units.rawText: If we lighten the ship... it ought to go faster.
units.displayText: If we lighten the ship... it ought to go faster.

spans.text: If we lighten the ship... it ought to go faster.

units.rawText: Make sure you don't dump all our ballast, our ship needs some weight to maintain its balance!
units.displayText: Make sure you don't dump all our ballast, our ship needs some weight to maintain its balance!

spans.text: Make sure you don't dump all our ballast, our ship needs some weight to maintain its balance!

units.rawText: O...okay!
units.displayText: O...okay!

spans.text: O...okay!

units.rawText: How are they moving so fast... Get back here!
units.displayText: How are they moving so fast... Get back here!

spans.text: How are they moving so fast... Get back here!

units.rawText: You will not stand in our way.
units.displayText: You will not stand in our way.

spans.text: You will not stand in our way.

units.rawText: Boom—Another cannonball strikes the Witch.
units.displayText: Boom—Another cannonball strikes the Witch.

spans.text: Boom—Another cannonball strikes the Witch.

units.rawText: Damn you, Priestess!
units.displayText: Damn you, Priestess!

spans.text: Damn you, Priestess!

units.rawText: Take the currents into consideration... as well as the wind direction...
units.displayText: Take the currents into consideration... as well as the wind direction...

spans.text: Take the currents into consideration... as well as the wind direction...

units.rawText: And then the weight of the vessel... Alright, left full rudder!
units.displayText: And then the weight of the vessel... Alright, left full rudder!

spans.text: And then the weight of the vessel... Alright, left full rudder!

units.rawText: No... That's impossible! You mean you weren't going at full speed just now!?
units.displayText: No... That's impossible! You mean you weren't going at full speed just now!?

spans.text: No... That's impossible! You mean you weren't going at full speed just now!?

units.rawText: Under Captain Yanny's direction, the ship uses the whirlwind that just took form and speeds away from the island at a disturbing angle.
units.displayText: Under Captain Yanny's direction, the ship uses the whirlwind that just took form and speeds away from the island at a disturbing angle.

spans.text: Under Captain Yanny's direction, the ship uses the whirlwind that just took form and speeds away from the island at a disturbing angle.

units.rawText: Hold it... Ugh... Dammit, I can't catch up!
units.displayText: Hold it... Ugh... Dammit, I can't catch up!

spans.text: Hold it... Ugh... Dammit, I can't catch up!

units.rawText: The Witch did not expect that the whirlwind she summoned would not only fail to trap the ship, but instead took them out of her grasp.
units.displayText: The Witch did not expect that the whirlwind she summoned would not only fail to trap the ship, but instead took them out of her grasp.

spans.text: The Witch did not expect that the whirlwind she summoned would not only fail to trap the ship, but instead took them out of her grasp.

units.rawText: Fire!
units.displayText: Fire!

spans.text: Fire!

units.rawText: Meanwhile, the cannon on the ship has been firing nonstop, as the crew seizes every chance they can get to delay the witch.
units.displayText: Meanwhile, the cannon on the ship has been firing nonstop, as the crew seizes every chance they can get to delay the witch.

spans.text: Meanwhile, the cannon on the ship has been firing nonstop, as the crew seizes every chance they can get to delay the witch.

units.rawText: Come back here!
units.displayText: Come back here!

spans.text: Come back here!

units.rawText: Adjust the sails by 30 degrees! Rudder amidships!
units.displayText: Adjust the sails by 30 degrees! Rudder amidships!

spans.text: Adjust the sails by 30 degrees! Rudder amidships!

units.rawText: With everyone's cooperation, the ship soon breaks free of the cloud cover. We soon leave the image of the Wicked Witch behind us, and she shrinks into a tiny dot.
units.displayText: With everyone's cooperation, the ship soon breaks free of the cloud cover. We soon leave the image of the Wicked Witch behind us, and she shrinks into a tiny dot.

spans.text: With everyone's cooperation, the ship soon breaks free of the cloud cover. We soon leave the image of the Wicked Witch behind us, and she shrinks into a tiny dot.

units.rawText: (Pants heavily) I can't see the Witch any more...
units.displayText: (Pants heavily) I can't see the Witch any more...

spans.text: (Pants heavily) I can't see the Witch any more...

units.rawText: We... We did it...
units.displayText: We... We did it...

spans.text: We... We did it...

units.rawText: Justice always triumphs.
units.displayText: Justice always triumphs.

spans.text: Justice always triumphs.

units.rawText: (Sniffle) ...Thank goodness...
units.displayText: (Sniffle) ...Thank goodness...

spans.text: (Sniffle) ...Thank goodness...

units.rawText: Too bad we didn't get a way to break the Princess' curse from the Witch.
units.displayText: Too bad we didn't get a way to break the Princess' curse from the Witch.

spans.text: Too bad we didn't get a way to break the Princess' curse from the Witch.

units.rawText: Destiny decrees that we will encounter each other again.
units.displayText: Destiny decrees that we will encounter each other again.

spans.text: Destiny decrees that we will encounter each other again.

units.rawText: After all, we have a piece of coal that she prizes.
units.displayText: After all, we have a piece of coal that she prizes.

spans.text: After all, we have a piece of coal that she prizes.

units.rawText: We can't let this fall into the Witch's hands, though.
units.displayText: We can't let this fall into the Witch's hands, though.

spans.text: We can't let this fall into the Witch's hands, though.

units.rawText: Hmm... This IS a big problem.
units.displayText: Hmm... This IS a big problem.

spans.text: Hmm... This IS a big problem.

units.rawText: Everyone seems a little depressed. The thought of future crises leaves them silent.
units.displayText: Everyone seems a little depressed. The thought of future crises leaves them silent.

spans.text: Everyone seems a little depressed. The thought of future crises leaves them silent.

units.rawText: Well, we can't solve the problems of the future by thinking about them now. Rather than be bothered by this, why don't we celebrate the fact that we escaped the clutches of the Wicked Witch?
units.displayText: Well, we can't solve the problems of the future by thinking about them now. Rather than be bothered by this, why don't we celebrate the fact that we escaped the clutches of the Wicked Witch?

units.displayText: (Rumble)

units.rawText: Urgh... I got hungry the moment I relaxed...
units.displayText: Urgh... I got hungry the moment I relaxed...

spans.text: Urgh... I got hungry the moment I relaxed...

units.displayText: I'll go clear a table!

units.displayText: What a lovely scene.

spans.text: What a lovely scene.

units.rawText: As I look at the miniatures representing our characters, I can almost see the crew dancing and singing in celebration of their triumph.
units.displayText: As I look at the miniatures representing our characters, I can almost see the crew dancing and singing in celebration of their triumph.

spans.text: As I look at the miniatures representing our characters, I can almost see the crew dancing and singing in celebration of their triumph.

units.rawText: Whew... What a lovely scene.

units.displayText: I exhale and look at the translucent figurine in my hand.
